support.faq1q: How do I reset my password?
support.faq1a: Go to the Login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email address and we will send you a link to reset your password.
support.faq2q: How do I verify a certificate?
support.faq2a: Visit the Certificate Verification page and enter the certificate ID. You can find the ID on your certificate document.
support.faq3q: Can I access courses for free?
support.faq3a: Yes! ELMKUSOMA offers a free tier with access to select courses, recorded classes, and the digital library. Premium content requires a subscription.
support.faq4q: How do I contact my instructor?
support.faq4a: You can reach instructors through the live class chat during sessions or through the course discussion board.
support.faq5q: How do I enroll in a school program?
support.faq5a: Browse the Schools section, select your education level, choose an institution, and click 'Apply for Admission' to start the enrollment process.
support.faq6q: What payment methods do you accept?
support.faq6a: We accept mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money), bank transfers, and credit/debit cards.
